name: PT Indorig Mitra Sejati
tagline: One stop shopping for core drilling machine & equipment. Based in Indonesia.

hero.lead: We build, modify and support core drilling rigs for mineral exploration, mining and geothermal, from our base in Cikarang, Bekasi.

about.vision: “To engineer the future through relentless innovation and uncompromising drilling solutions.”
about.lead: Founded in 2019, Indorig Mitra Sejati is a trusted supplier in the drilling industry, specializing in core drilling solutions for mineral exploration, including gold, tin, and other valuable resources. One stop shopping for core drilling machine & equipment.

bmsl.title: Build
bmsl.text: Manufacturing highly durable drilling machines for extreme conditions.

bmsl.title: Modify
bmsl.text: Providing adaptive, custom engineering tailored to client specifications.

bmsl.title: Support
bmsl.text: Delivering reliable after-sales maintenance to guarantee zero downtime.

founder.imageAlt: Sugeng Prio Darminto, founder of Indorig Mitra Sejati
founder.lead: We don't just manufacture equipment. We engineer solutions built from a driller's perspective. Our founder brings over 30 years of national and international technical experience in the drilling industry, across Indonesia, Southeast Asia, and Africa.

points.title: 30+ years of field operations
points.text: Hands-on mechanical maintenance, drilling operations, and technical problem-solving in demanding environments.

points.title: Industry veteran
points.text: Pelsart Group of Companies, Coredrill IndoAsia, Radial Drilling, Stanley Mining Services, and PT Indodrill Indonesia.

points.title: Technical mastery
points.text: Hydraulics, Diamond & RC drilling, mud pump systems, heavy equipment maintenance, commissioning, and troubleshooting.

founder.name: Sugeng Prio Darminto (Ciko)
